paragraphs.text: Syr Carah , the Bold , is a human knight of Eldraine .

Syr Carah is a knight of Embereth . While not much is known about her background, it is known that the knights of Embereth are famously optimistic and singularly certain that anything is achievable so long as they face it head-on. They tend to be gregarious and confident and are always willing to try new experiences. Due to this, they are not particularly long-lived. As a show of courage, Embereth knights never carry shields and often incorporate the broken shields of opponents into their armor.

Embereth's knights are said to be intrigued by irrationally dangerous quests, believing that the most frightening challenges are the ones most worth conquering. Due to this, knights of Embereth are particularly skilled at facing supernatural dangers that would cause weaker knights to quail in fear. In addition to fighting monstrous threats, they also undertake quests to conquer their fears. A knight might seek to slay a faerie that terrorized them as a child, a witch that took their mother, or a giant that sat on their lover's house.
